mcqs.question: Under the supplementary support measures for weavers in Andhra Pradesh, free power for powerloom units is provided up to how many units per month, benefiting how many units?
options: Up to 200 units per month for 62,541 families
Up to 500 units per month for 10,032 units
Up to 500 units per month for 62,541 families
Up to 200 units per month for 10,032 units
mcqs.explanation: Free power for powerloom units is provided up to 500 units per month, benefiting 10,032 units. The figures 200 units and 62,541 families relate to the separate handloom free-power support, not the powerloom measure.
